meta.name: review-plan
meta.description: Stress-test a plan file before committing to implementation. Catches architectural mistakes, convention violations, and missing dependencies while changes are still cheap. Invoked directly, not routed from coding-process.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实施前压力测试计划方案，找出架构错误和缺失依赖
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在动手编码前快速验证计划方案的可行性
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to validate a plan's feasibility before coding begins

howto.what: 它审查计划文件，找出架构错误、约定违规和缺失依赖，并在修改代价最小时提出必须修复、应该修复和可考虑改进的问题。
howto.when: 当你直接要求它审查一份计划文件（如 plan.html 或 .md 文件）时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个 plan.html 文件
say.note: 它会加载计划并检查技术合理性

say.text: 检查我的计划有没有遗漏的依赖
say.note: 它会遍历增量间的依赖排序

howto.what_en: It reviews plan files to catch architectural mistakes, convention violations, and missing dependencies while changes are cheap, and outputs MUST FIX, SHOULD FIX, and CONSIDER items.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you directly ask it to review a plan file (e.g., plan.html or .md).

say_en.note: It loads and checks technical soundness

say_en.text: Check if my plan misses any dependencies
